Full-Time Sidekick to Samantha Skyring, Founder and CEO of Oryx Desert Salt

 

About Sidekick

We help founders (and other busy humans) escape admin overload by pairing them with hand-picked assistants who protect their clients' most valuable resource; time. We're a small team of kind, big-hearted, excellence-obsessed people who genuinely love helping people thrive. See our website for more info: www.sidekick.cool

 

About The Role

Location: In-office role in Muizenberg

Some founders build companies. Samantha Skyring built a South African icon. Oryx Desert Salt has gone from an idea to a brand that sits on tables around the world, and Samantha is the force behind it: high output, high standards, deeply people driven, and built for adventure & impact.

 

We are looking for a full-time EA (Sidekick) to become her second hand, someone poised, sharp, and genuinely good with people, who can step into a room, a client call, or a tricky conversation and represent her, and the brand, without missing a beat.

 

This is not a back-office role. You will be in the room, on the calls, and in the follow-through. You will manage her inbox and calendar, work closely with the team inside Oryx, and often accompany Samantha to meetings and events, which means you need to carry yourself with the same warmth, polish and confidence that built this brand in the first place. If you love people, understand how a brand shows up in every interaction, and want a front-row seat while an iconic South African company keeps growing, this one is for you.

 

What you'll be working on

Supporting the CEO

  • Running calendar, inbox and follow-ups so nothing slips and nothing waits longer than it should

  • Accompanying her to meetings, client visits and events, prepped, present, and representing her well

  • Catching the loose threads before they become fires, and fighting the ones that do

 

Client & Relationship Management

  • Being a genuinely trusted, on-time voice with clients, buyers and partners, someone they enjoy dealing with

  • Taking calls on Samantha's behalf with the same warmth and professionalism she brings

  • Following commercial and client conversations through to an actual close-out, not just "we'll get to it"

  • Spotting and following up on opportunities to grow or deepen a client relationship

 

Brand & Social Presence

  • Understanding the Oryx brand well enough to represent it in any room, call or client interaction

  • Keeping an eye on the brand's social media presence, flagging opportunities, tracking engagement, and helping coordinate content with the marketing team

  • Supporting Samantha's personal and public-facing presence, from event coverage to the small details that shape how she and the brand are seen

  • Bringing a sharp eye for packaging, presentation and how the business shows up to the outside world

 

Working Across Teams

  • Being the connective tissue between departments, the person every team can rely on, proactively

  • Coordinating with the team inside Oryx so projects, requests and priorities keep moving

  • Creating clarity between people and teams, especially when priorities compete

  • Logistics, Ecommerce, Packaging, Imports & Exports, Key Accounts, etc.

 

Admin & Projects

  • Running projects that actually land, from idea to completion

  • Keeping key documents, reports and schedules accurate and on time

  • Taking initiative on process improvements that make the business run smoother

 

Who you are

  • Poised, polished, and genuinely comfortable representing someone else in high-stakes or client-facing moments

  • Love people, reading a room, building trust quickly, and making others feel taken care of

  • Extremely reliable and trustworthy, especially with sensitive or confidential information

  • Curious, open-minded, humble, and actively seek feedback to grow

  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, without losing sight of the bigger relationship or brand picture

  • A great communicator who manages expectations and creates clarity

  • Comfortable making decisions and following through without being chased

  • Proactive, and instinctively takes initiative

 

Skills You'll Need

Sales

  • Confident building and maintaining client relationships, with an instinct for spotting opportunities

  • Comfortable representing the business on calls and in meetings, and closing out commercial conversations

  • Persuasive communicator who can read what a client needs and respond well under pressure

Operations

  • Strong organisational skills: calendar, inbox and project management at a fast pace

  • Able to manage multiple moving priorities at once without dropping the ball

  • Process-minded, with the ability to spot inefficiencies and fix them

 

Brand Management

  • An eye for how a brand should look, sound and feel across every touchpoint, from packaging to social media

  • Working knowledge of social media platforms and content coordination (Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.)

  • Understands how to protect and elevate a brand's reputation in every interaction, online and in person

Requirements

  • Valid driver's license and your own car

  • Experience in a client-facing, sales, account management, or brand-related role

  • Corporate experience

  • Proficient in MS Office

  • Comfortable learning new systems and tools

  • Preferred formal education in: Industrial Psychology; Business Administration / Commerce (BCom); Marketing / Brand Management; Communications / Public Relations

Some people are just wired to connect with others and make things run smoothly around them. If that's you, and you take quiet pride in doing things properly and representing people well, we'd love to hear from you. All the best with your application, we're rooting for you!

raw.title: Sidekick (Personal/Executive Assistant) / Cape Town
raw.descriptionHtml:
About Sidekick

We help Founders, CEO's, Directors (and other busy humans) escape admin overload by pairing them with hand-picked assistants who protect their clients' most valuable resource; time. We're a small team of kind, big-hearted, excellence-obsessed people who genuinely love helping people thrive.

See our website for more info: www.sidekick.cool

 

The Role As a Sidekick...

You'll work full or part-time with one or more clients, supporting them across their personal and professional lives. No two days look the same, and that's exactly why this role suits people who are organised, adaptable and energised by variety. You'll be matched with clients whose needs align with your skills and experience. Over time, many Sidekicks grow into indispensable partners in their clients' lives.

 

We're currently looking for Sidekicks based in or around Cape Town who thrive in fast-paced, high-agency environments, and who are process-driven, for hybrid client support.

 

Personal Assistance Depending on your client, you might be helping with:

  • Calendar ping pong and wrangling someone's schedule before it wrangles them

  • Planning an epic overseas trip (that doesn't involve a 14-hour layover in Dubai)

  • Finding birthday gifts that are thoughtful, on time (and not a regift of your granny's bath soaps)

  • Planning & organising meals that are thoughtfully curated to your clients needs

  • Being the person who anticipates your clients personal needs like, booking doctor's appointments, scheduling that overdue eye test, and more.

  • Decoding a medical aid claim before it becomes a 6-month saga

  • Keeping the finances from becoming a shoebox of receipts and good intentions

  • Taking their car in for a service before they knew it was due

  • Completing tedious paperwork for applications and being the main point of contact for your client

 

Business Assistance or on the professional side, you could be working on things like:

  • Taming the inbox that multiplies like rabbits - triaging, drafting, unsubscribing, actually replying

  • Booking and wrangling a high volume of calls and meetings before they wrangle your client's diary

  • Fixing calendar sync issues across platforms (Google, Outlook) so nothing gets missed

  • Turning chaotic notes, voice memos and meeting notes into neatly-organised and actionable projects & tasks

  • Building and maintaining the systems, standard operating procedures, meeting rhythms and information that keeps everything organised and everyone sane

  • Getting password and access management properly locked down across a team

  • Keeping the money stuff moving - invoices, receipts, expenses, and the bookkeeping your client has been 'about to do' for three months

  • Building team culture and celebrating people - birthdays, all-hands, year-end functions, the moments that matter

  • Managing socials so your client has a presence without it consuming their existence

  • Creating the deep-dive research docs, slide decks, and spreadsheets your client keeps bumping to 'when things are quieter' (they won't be)

  • Keeping the office running - supplies, lunches, deliveries, cleaners, visitors, the stuff nobody notices until it stops working

  • Planning the work trip down to the last detail. Flights, hotels, transfers, restaurants, and the backup plan when something inevitably goes wrong.

 

Who you are

  • Genuinely love helping others, solving their problems, and being willing to go the extra mile to bring joy and order to their lives

  • Process-driven and analytical, you'd rather follow (and improve) a good system than freestyle

  • Extremely reliable and trustworthy

  • Curious, open-minded, humble, and actively seek feedback to continuously grow and improve

  • Highly organised, thorough and a detail-oriented perfectionist

  • A great communicator who expertly manages expectations and creates clarity

  • Positive, enthusiastic, uplifting energy

  • Builds strong, professional relationships with clients

  • Proactive and takes initiative

  • Willingness to run errands and find joy in the mundane tasks

 

Requirements

  • Fluent in English

  • Based in or able to reliably commute to Cape Town

  • Valid driver's license and your own car

  • Tech-savvy and enjoy adopting new tools (e.g. Claude, Notion, etc.)

 

Compensation, application process & other FAQs

Please visit our Careers page.

 

Good luck!

Some people are just wired to help. If that's you, and you take quiet pride in doing things properly, we'd love to hear from you. All the best with your application, we're rooting for you!
